title: Deliver Maize to Wrinfingbridge Food Processing Plant
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Maize** delivered to **Wrinfingbridge Food Processing Plant** (industry id 3, near tile 40,31).

A likely supplier is **Wondinghead Farm** (industry id 11, near tile 72,25); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.
